selection: Preselected seen programs: four distinct training families with real S0/S1 actions; two separate validation families. No selection by new timings. No test programs.

behavior.nonadvance: uniform structural stratum (kind, enclosing function, loop depth, callee), then uniform member

training.batch: one seeded-cycled trajectory per training program per update, equal family then program then trajectory; common schedule across models
training.selection: fixed-final-200; no validation-based tuning or extra seed

limits: No new actions, tree enumeration, unchosen-action labels, ranking loss, RL, tuning, test domain, hashes or historical matrix. Default is a reference only. S2 has no q supervision.
